EC1: Acute heart failure [OR] or acute exacerbation [AND] of chronic heart failure within the past 2 weeks.
EC2: Scheduled cardiac resynchronization therapy [OR] or heart transplantation.
EC3: History of malignant tumor [OR] or life expectancy under 12 months.
EC4: Already on medications [AND] that may affect thyroid function (L-T4 [OR], carbimazole [OR], propylthiouracil [OR], amiodarone [OR], lithium).
EC6: Participation in another clinical trial within the past 30 days.
EC7: Contraindication [OR] or intolerance [AND] to evidence-based therapy [AND] for CHF, such as beta-blocker [OR], angiotensin-converting enzyme inhibitor [OR] or angiotensin receptor blocker.
EC8: Known hypersensitivity to the trial [OR] treatment(s) or diluents (when applicable), including placebo [OR] or other comparator drug(s).
EC12: Treatment [AND] with levothyroxine must not be initiated in patients with acute myocardial infarction [OR], acute myocarditis [OR], or acute pancarditis.
EC15: Any disorder which, in the opinion of the investigator, might jeopardise subject's safety or compliance with the protocol.
